entry_points.text: One helper translates with write flag. Segmented ops translate then call standard handlers as non-system; linear system ops skip translation as system.

exports.text: Backdoor PMC check affirms three compat selectors only, letting callers skip privilege there; must confine bypass to those.

hazards.text: Raw vector moves allow zero to fifteen with upper half 64b-only else fatal bug. Fault-safe exec returns unhandleable on fault else continuation.

invariants.text: Intercept packs prefix, modrm, operands, sizes and IPs then forwards to ops. Faults reject vectors above 31 else record and propagate via wrappers. GPRs cache with valid and dirty and lazy ops load. Bug check warns once, taints and returns truthy.

Addrs truncate by width with 16, 32 or 64b stack wrap. Seg base zeroes low segs in 64b, virt is 57b with LA57 else 48b. Linearize checks canonical, limits, perms and alignment faulting stack or protection. Fetch caps 15B total and page rest else faults. ModRM handles 16b and SIB forms. Reg picks vector or GPR forms. Descs read size then addr, scans suppress on zero, imm and branch flags follow width and type rules.

Real derives base keeping attrs, virtual builds fresh user descs. Code, stack, task and table checks enforce type and priv, persist accessed or busy atomically and validate 64b base. Shadow-stack invalid blocks 64b exit. Entries are 8B with index high and null below four.

Reads stage in positional replay cache, bit ops shift by bytes, port strings prefetch bursts, IDT bounds-checks, abs width follows addr size. Writeback picks reg, mem, string or vector. Push reserves then stores and pop reverses with masked flags. Far installs code then pointer, near repoints with push or pop, exchange redirects on mismatch, seg-ptr installs then copies. Real int and return complete only in real mode via push and vector or pop and merge.
Privilege precheck passes real and gates others. Port auth skips backdoor when enabled else tests TSS bitmap at 102 with sticky success. Intel 32b strings clear count and truncate indices on zero.

Strings step per direction, decimal adjusts fix nibbles and bytes, divide adjust faults on zero. Exchange uses locked mem, multiply forwards, swap reverses, extend propagates. Swapped moves need support. ID and counter reads split 64b with GP on backend fail.

Control writes use backend with CR0 recalculating mode, MSR splits halves, ext control needs save support. Only valid CR and DR pass with alias and masking rules. Seg and table honor prevention, size and canonical checks. Invalidation notifies, hypercalls rewind, ports delegate, flag sets check priv, ID needs perm, flushes NOP, FP sizes follow mode, x87 faults on task bits.

Debug needs zero high half. Virtualization needs EFER bit with addr check first. Timestamp faults on disabled priv, counter grants backdoor else needs enable. Ports cap width four then test. Gates exit continue, opcode fault or protection fault suppressing exec.

Tables use compact constructors with dual, group and escape selectors and shared invalid entry. System splits hypercall, monitor, control and timestamp; arith spans logic, shifts and muldiv; primary handles data, string, stack and branch; two-byte vectors and bits; 38 map only swapped moves, all with permission gating.
Uses external copy, set, minima, page, bit, build, thread and bug or warn helpers owned elsewhere.
Raw vector allows low regs always and extended 64b-only for wide and legacy with eight media regs; invalid is host bug.

locks.text: Host FP guarded by paired get and put; all x87 and vector work brackets there, with no persistence across writes.

state_machines.text: Mode picks real, v86, 16, 32 or 64b from protection, virtual, long and code size, rejecting bad long combos. IP truncates, revalidates via fetch, commits only on success.

Task wrapper saves IP, delegates, restores and commits on success else fails. Switch checks descs and gate priv, rejects TSS32 below 0x67 and TSS16 below 0x2b with width and busy rules, updates busy and nested, sets TS, reloads TR, pushes errors and clears debug locals. Persists outgoing, links prev unless all-ones, loads incoming. TSS16 holds offset, flags, regs and sels; TSS32 holds pointer, flags, regs and sels omitting base refs; loads force flag bit1 and install sels then descs.

RSM faults outside management or triple faults on bad exit else recalculates mode. Syscall faults in real, v86, bad Intel mode or disabled ext else installs flat descs and saves return with long versus legacy rules. Sysenter faults on bad mode or zero code, else installs selectors and promotes. Sysexit faults in real or v86 else forces user priv, validates selectors and pointers then installs.

Near calls capture return then push, far calls validate code and restore on fail without undoing push, rets pop then adjust. Loop branches on nonzero count with condition, count-zero only on zero. FP save and restore check support and task bits, reject 64b, save under protection, restore with padding and GP on reserved bits.

structs.text: Flat code and stack use zero base, 4K gran, 4G limit, present, 32b supervisor; backdoor ports are hex 5658 and 5659.
